title: Settings
description: Personal preferences (this browser) and shared server settings.

personal.scopeNote: These are stored in this browser only — they don't sync across browsers or devices, and don't affect other users.

language.title: Language
language.label: UI language
language.persistedHint: Saved to localStorage; takes effect immediately.

theme.title: Theme
theme.label: Color theme
theme.persistedHint: Saved to localStorage; takes effect immediately.

server.scopeNote: These are saved on the server and shared by everyone. Changes take effect for the whole deployment.

agentPrune.title: Long-offline agent cleanup
agentPrune.description: Automatically remove agents (PCs) that stopped sending heartbeats this long ago. Offline machines that come back reappear on their next heartbeat, so only genuinely-retired ones stay gone.
agentPrune.label: Prune after no heartbeat for
agentPrune.blankHint: Leave blank to use the default (shown faintly). With no default, blank means cleanup is off — long-offline agents are kept forever.

controllerGroup.title: Controller group (trusted runners)
controllerGroup.description: The agent group whose members may run `tier: controller` jobs (e.g. a `feed:` job that fetches an external URL). These jobs are never dispatched to employee endpoints — only to members of this group.
controllerGroup.label: Controller group name
controllerGroup.blankHint: Leave blank and controller-tier jobs run nowhere (fail-safe) — the safe default so an external fetch never lands on an endpoint by accident.
